bio.text: Val Hoyle has represented Oregon's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2023.
She served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2010, eventually as Majority Leader, and was later elected statewide as Oregon's Labor Commissioner.
Hoyle graduated from Emmanuel College with a bachelor's degree in political science and worked for 25 years in the international bicycle industry before entering politics.
She was born on Travis Air Force Base in California and lives in Lane County with her husband and two children.
